name: Splatting-Based AMR Volume Rendering
aliases: Hierarchical Splatting for AMR Volume Rendering
Hierarchical Splatting with k-d-tree and Octree
definition: A volume rendering technique using kD-tree and octree-based domain subdivision to specify isovalue ranges and transfer functions, rendering via hierarchical splatting.
summary: Splatting-Based AMR Volume Rendering efficiently renders non-uniform scalar fields by converting AMR hierarchies into k-d-trees augmented with octrees to cull irrelevant isovalue ranges.
